story_title: As the assigned Event Coordinator, I want to set up attendee registration for an event so that Attendees can register only when, and in the numbers, the event allows

acceptance_criteria.text: The assigned Event Coordinator can enable or disable attendee registration for an event.
The Coordinator can set a registration capacity for the event.
The registration capacity cannot exceed the capacity of the event's booked venue for its selected room layout.

Given the event has more than one venue booking, when the Coordinator sets the registration capacity, then they select which venue booking the capacity is measured against, and the capacity cannot exceed that venue's capacity for its selected layout (see SPM-81).
The Coordinator can set a registration opening date and closing date that are separate from the event date.
The closing date cannot be earlier than the opening date or later than the event's start.
The Coordinator can extend or reopen a closed registration period, provided the event has not started.

Given registration is enabled, when the settings are incomplete (no capacity or no registration period), then the event's registration setup is shown as an outstanding arrangement (see Track Outstanding Arrangements).

Given Attendees are registered or on the waiting list, when the Coordinator lowers the registration capacity below that number or disables registration, then the change is saved and the event's registrations are flagged for review rather than changed (see SPM-68).
The Event Organiser can view the registration settings for their event but cannot change them.
Users other than the assigned Coordinator cannot change registration settings.

open_questions: RESOLVED 2026-10-09: written before the code, then checked against the built code on 2026-10-09: every message, label and page address in the cases is what the code shows (27 page tests in src/app/__tests__/event-registration-pages.test.tsx render the Overview with the cases' wording), and the server side of every case was run against the SPM64 fixtures on the shared database through the running app's API (all 29 checks as expected). Corrected while checking: the app writes September as 'Sept' (en-GB), the rejected room in TC09 is Marina Grand Hall (no 'Marina Bay Ballroom' is seeded), 'SPM64 Orchard Data Forum' moved to 18 Mar 2027 and 'SPM64 Attendee Open Day' to 13 May 2027 (their rooms were already booked on the first dates), and TC01 now lists the 'Measured against' row and the incomplete-setup alert. Not yet clicked through by a person in a browser.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: the story has 11 ACs. The draft's AC12 ('Update Event Information does not edit registration settings') was dropped: SPM-62's strict schema already refuses those fields, and no regression cases are written for it.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: where. The existing 'Registration' card on the event's Overview. For the assigned coordinator, while the event is Approved, Planning or Confirmed, the card header has a 'Change registration settings' button. It turns the card into a form with: the checkbox 'Attendees need to register for this event', 'Registration capacity', 'Capacity measured against' (only when the event has two or more pending or approved venue bookings), 'Registration opens', 'Registration closes', and the buttons 'Save registration settings' and 'Cancel'. After a save, the card is read-only again, with a green alert 'Registration settings saved.' and, if the save flagged anything, a 'Flagged for review' list in SPM-62's style. Answer: confirmed. The settings live on the existing Registration card rather than on a new page, because the organiser and every other role already see that card read-only, so AC10 and AC11 need no new screen. The button and form are only for the assigned coordinator in Approved, Planning or Confirmed. The form uses noValidate so the page's own messages show, not the browser's.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: the read-only card. 'Registration': 'Enabled' or 'Not enabled for this event'. When enabled: 'Capacity' (or '—'), 'Measured against' as '<venue name> (<code>), <Layout> layout – up to <n>' (or '—'), 'Opens' and 'Closes' as dates and times (or '—'). Disabling keeps the saved values: they show again when registration is turned back on. Answer: confirmed, with one addition. An attendee never sees 'Measured against': which booking the capacity is measured against is internal planning information, so it stays off ATTENDEE_EVENT_FIELDS. Everyone else who can see the event sees it.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: messages. A capacity that isn't a whole number of at least 1: 'Enter a whole number, at least 1.' (as on the event request form). Over the limit: 'Registration capacity can't be more than <n>, the capacity of <venue> (<code>) in its <Layout> layout.' No pending or approved booking: 'Book a venue for this event before setting a registration capacity.' A booking with no layout: 'The venue booking has no room layout, so its capacity isn't known. Book the venue with a room layout first.' Several bookings and none chosen: 'Choose which venue booking the capacity is measured against.' Closing not after opening: 'Registration closes at must be after it opens.' (as on the request form). Closing after the start: 'Registration must close no later than the event starts.' A period change once the event has started: 'The event has started, so the registration period can't be changed.' Each message shows under its own field, and nothing is saved. Answer: confirmed. Two are reused word for word from the event request form so the app says the same thing in both places ('Enter a whole number, at least 1.', 'Registration closes at must be after it opens.'). 'Registration must close no later than the event starts.' is deliberately different from the request form's 'Registration must close before the event starts.', because this story allows closing exactly at the start (AC6). An empty capacity is NOT an error here, unlike on the request form ('Enter how many attendees can register.'): AC8 requires that an incomplete setup can be saved.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: the limit is the room's capacity for the booked layout (VenueLayout, #112), never the room's maximum capacity. Pending and approved bookings count; rejected and cancelled bookings are never offered and never count. With one such booking it's used automatically and no 'Capacity measured against' field is shown. Answer: confirmed (agreed in step 0 of plan.md, customer answer #112).

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: the period (AC5, AC6). Opening must be strictly before closing, so an equal time is refused. Closing may be at the event's start exactly, but not after it. Extending or reopening (AC7, #42, #127) is just changing 'Registration closes' to a later time, even when the old one has passed. Any change to the dates is refused once the event has started. Answer: confirmed (agreed in step 0, customer answers #30 and #42). No separate rule is needed for the opening date against the event start: opening before closing and closing no later than the start already put it before the start.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: outstanding (AC8, #80). While registration is enabled, the card shows an amber alert 'Registration setup is incomplete' when the capacity, the opening date or the closing date is missing ('Still needed: registration capacity, opening date, closing date.', listing only what is missing), or when the booking the capacity was measured against is no longer pending or approved ('The venue booking the capacity was measured against is no longer active. Choose another booking.'). The alert goes as soon as all of these are met, or when registration is disabled. Saving an incomplete setup is never refused. It is listed as an outstanding arrangement, and 'Confirm event' is refused with SPM-34's message: 'This event cannot be confirmed yet: registration setup is incomplete (still needed: …).' or '… registration capacity is measured against a venue booking that is no longer active.' An event already Confirmed stays Confirmed. Answer: confirmed (agreed 2026-10-09 with Sammi Chua, including the lost-booking condition from Week 7 change #4).

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: flags (AC9). The 'Flagged for review' line reads 'Registrations: <n> attendees – the registration capacity was lowered below the number registered or waitlisted' or '… – registration was turned off'. <n> counts registered and waitlisted attendees, not withdrawn ones. Lowering to exactly <n> flags nothing. Answer: confirmed. The line follows SPM-62's 'Flagged for review' format ('Registrations: 12 attendees – the date or time changed') and its attendee count wording ('1 attendee' / '<n> attendees'), so SPM-68 lists every story's flags the same way.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09 (#10): a registered or waitlisted attendee keeps seeing a Confirmed event after its registration is turned off. A withdrawn attendee does not, and sees 'This event doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.' Answer: confirmed (agreed 2026-10-09 with Sammi Chua).

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: who. Only the coordinator assigned to the event, only in Approved, Planning or Confirmed (SPM-62's window; Postponed is excluded). The organiser (AC10) and everyone else (AC11) see the read-only card with no button. Answer: confirmed (agreed in step 0; same window as SPM-62).

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: out of scope, so no cases. Attendee sign-up enforcing the dates and capacity, the waiting list (#26, #44), VIPs added over capacity (#99, #33), per-session capacity (#74), a derived Open/Closed label (#127), and clearing a flag (SPM-68).

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: Not reachable from the screens, so covered by unit tests only: a booking from another event sent as the measured booking; a request from a non-coordinator that bypasses the hidden button; that a flag is merged into an existing registration review reason rather than replacing it; and that Registration rows are never changed by a save (no attendee list screen exists to show it). Answer: noted. Each is covered by a route or unit test in its slice.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: fixtures. `npm run fixtures:spm64` (scripts/seed-spm64.ts) deletes and recreates only the twelve 'SPM64 …' events (seed keys spm64_*), with their bookings, measured booking, registration settings and registrations; the same events (without those) are at the end of prisma/seed.ts. It stops without changing anything if one of its rooms is already held at that time. No pinned reference numbers: find each event by title.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: navigation in TC24. Venue Staff reach an event from 'Booking Requests' (pending requests link to the event). Technical Support has no sidebar link to any event Overview (NAV_BY_ROLE), so their step types /events. That gap is recorded in DOCUMENTATION.md Known Gaps, not fixed in SPM-64. Answer: confirmed by Sammi Chua, 2026-10-09.
